behaviour.grid: 3 cols >=768 (gap 24px lg / 16px md); 1 col below (gap 8px) with horizontal tiles (label left, arrow right, 64px tall)
behaviour.hover: ::before gradient layer linear-gradient(60deg,#762858 8%,#d52331 25%,#ee4956 45%,#f2abb1 53%,#fff 70%), 300% size, fixed attachment: opacity 0->1, scale .935->1 (300ms ease-out) + gradient-shift .45s (background-position 100% 100% -> 0 0); text white + label underline; arrow white, translateX 8px

visualCharacteristics.purpose: Text-only link tiles with a decorative arrow and an animated red gradient fill on hover; 3 columns >= 768px, stacked horizontal tiles below

contentPattern.structure: one row per tile: cell 1 image (leave empty); cell 2 rich text with one linked title

usage: Home 'Popular topics' section (section style split; heading and subtitle are default content).
reuseGuidance: Short lists of topic / resource links.
